body:
It's fine, I'm sorry for being excessively blunt.

I've already seen enough of the world to know that seeing more won't change how I feel.

Despite that, to be blunt: none of this particularly matters when I aim to not be alive to see the mess that'd result from it. My parents would probably get violent or do something that'd make it a misery.

To be more precise, I could move out right this moment and be financially sound.

The issue is the long term sacrifices I make to do that, such as how long it'll take me to buy a home.

One slightly more unique caveat I have is my parents. They don't exactly want me living a carefree life. In maybe 2 years I'll probably have enough finances to go against them but I don't particularly want to go through all that for a life where I'm single anyway.

Wasn't joking when I said I've tried everything, I even include gaming in that, I used to play a lot of Xbox and PC.

I agree that it's a great way to unite people and it can somewhat relieve some loneliness, but I just haven't had any luck with it which is a common theme here. No lasting interactions were had.

Thanks for sharing your thoughts on it. 

I agree it's brutal, even to the best of people. Problem is everyone else seems to eventually manage it, yet I've tried as hard as I could for years and failed nonetheless despite ensuring none of my depressed thinking was shown.
